title: Design System: Christian Padilla, The Pipeline

headline.purpose: Section headings; one accent phrase may carry now-gold.

title-sm.purpose: Card and record titles; mobile menu entries at 28px. Display floor is 24px.

body.purpose: Ledes and paragraphs in Quiet Ivory.

ui.purpose: Buttons, nav links, contact values (13 to 15px).

label.purpose: Record field labels and stage names, followed by a value; never an eyebrow above a heading.

shadows.name: glass-float
shadows.purpose: Floating layers: nav, menus, dialog chrome, HUD, carousel arrows, rail tooltips (with blur(20px) saturate(140%) over rgb(16 16 19 / 0.68)).

shadows.name: hero-record
shadows.purpose: Hero portrait record and showcase frames.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: UI state changes, press, now-gold colour (700ms), rail stem.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Declared for sheets; unused in the shipped page.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: from opacity 0.2, translateY(18px), blur(8px); 900ms ease-out-expo; once at -12% viewport margin
motion.purpose: Content settling into view; skipped under reduced motion.

motion.name: signal
motion.value: signal 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) infinite (scale 1 to 3.2, opacity 0.55 to 0)
motion.purpose: Live status dots and the rail lead token.

motion.name: chase
motion.purpose: Scroll cue: one light down a hairline.

motion.name: now-gold
motion.purpose: Heading accent turns gold while its section is active.

components.css: :host{--color-ink-950:#060607;--color-ink-900:#0b0b0d;--color-ink-850:#101013;--color-ivory:#f4efe6;--color-gold:#d6b97c;--color-gold-bright:#efdcae;--color-gold-deep:#a48748;--color-line:rgb(244 239 230 / 0.09);--color-line-strong:rgb(244 239 230 / 0.16);}.ds-rail{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;height:220px;width:20px;margin:0 0 0 8px;padding:0;list-style:none;}.ds-rail::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:10px;bottom:10px;left:50%;width:1px;background:var(--color-line-strong);}.ds-rail::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:10px;left:50%;width:1px;height:calc((100% - 20px) * 0.5);background:rgb(214 185 124 / 0.7);}.ds-rail li{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;place-items:center;height:20px;}.ds-rail li::before{content:'';width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:9999px;border:1px solid rgb(244 239 230 / 0.3);background:var(--color-ink-950);}.ds-rail li.is-passed::before{border-color:var(--color-gold-deep);background:var(--color-gold-deep);}.ds-rail li.is-current::before{width:14px;height:14px;border:1px solid rgb(6 6 7 / 0.4);background:var(--color-gold);}.ds-rail li.is-current::after{content:'';position:absolute;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--color-gold);animation:ds-signal 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) infinite;}.ds-rail-name{position:absolute;left:28px;writing-mode:vertical-rl;transform:rotate(180deg);white-space:nowrap;font-family:'Mona Sans Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:0.6875rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgb(244 239 230 / 0.55);}@keyframes ds-signal{0%{transform:scale(1);opacity:0.55;}100%{transform:scale(3.2);opacity:0;}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.ds-rail li.is-current::after{animation:none;opacity:0;}}

narrative.overview:
The page is Christian's own lead pipeline and the visitor is the lead moving through it. Ten stages sit on a hairline rail; one gold lead token advances as the visitor reads, the stages behind it fill in, and the journey lands on Get In Touch. The world is a keynote stage: near-black grounds stepping up to raised graphite, ivory type, two slow warm stage lights and a fine film grain so large dark fields never band. Everything that is not "now" rests in ivory and graphite.

Density is generous and editorial. Sections breathe on one shared vertical rhythm; content sits in a 12-column grid inside an 80rem container. Hierarchy comes from scale (a large, tight Bodoni display against quiet Mona Sans text) and from the single reserved colour, never from boxes, badges or labels stacked above headings. Content is presented as records: cards read like CRM entries, with wide-tracked caps field labels followed by their values.

The world refuses the dark-glass freelancer template: gradient headings, gold glows around buttons and cards, and interchangeable glass cards. Glass exists, but only on layers that float above the page.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, champagne gold, spent only on what is current: the active stage, the lead token, primary actions, live signal pulses.
Hairline rules (1px ivory at 9% and 16%) and black shadows define every surface.
Bodoni Moda display set large and tight; Mona Sans for everything readable; tracked caps for labels.
Pills for every action and chip; large soft-cornered records for content.
Motion is custom ease-out, quick on press, slow and settling on reveal, and always yields to reduced motion.

rules.name: The Gold Is Now Rule
rules.body: Gold marks only what is current or what acts. Heading accent words rest in ivory and turn gold (700ms colour transition) only while their section is the active stage. Subtitles, tags, icons at rest, card borders at rest and body copy are never gold. Hover may borrow gold (borders at 30 to 50%, icon fills) because hover is the visitor's "now".

rules.name: The One Static Keyline Exception
rules.body: The hero portrait record carries a permanent gold keyline (gold at 40%, inner ring at 25%) and its "10+" field in gold. It is the opening record of the pipeline; do not extend permanent gold keylines to other cards.

rules.name: The Display Floor Rule
rules.body: Bodoni Moda is never set below 24px for content. The only smaller use is the "Christian Padilla." wordmark (17px in the nav, 20px in the footer), which is an identity asset, not type.

rules.name: The Label-Then-Value Rule
rules.body: Tracked caps label a value that follows them. They never sit above a heading as a section kicker or eyebrow.

rules.name: The Black Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is black. No coloured box-shadow, text-shadow or glow on any element; gold light exists only as ambient stage light in the background layers.

rules.name: The Floating Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass (graphite at 68%, 20px blur, 140% saturation, 10% ivory border) is used only on layers that float: nav, menus, dialog chrome, HUD, carousel arrows, rail tooltips. Cards on the page are records, never glass.

dos: **Do** reserve gold for the current stage, the lead token, primary actions, live signals, focus and hover; keep heading accents in ivory until their section is active.
**Do** separate surfaces with 1px hairlines (ivory at 9% or 16%) and pure black shadows with negative spread.
**Do** set headings in Bodoni Moda at 24px or larger with tight tracking, and everything readable in Mona Sans.
**Do** label record fields with 11px tracked caps (0.22em) followed by their value.
**Do** use full pills for anything pressable or naming a thing, and 24 to 32px corners for content records.
**Do** give every pressable element the 0.97 press scale with a 180ms ease-out-quint transition, and a 2px gold focus outline at 3px offset.
**Do** reveal content from faint (opacity 0.2 plus blur), never from invisible, and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
**Do** keep every section on the shared stage padding (clamp 72px to 120px).
donts: **Don't** put an eyebrow or kicker above a heading; stage names live in the nav readout and on the pipeline rail.
**Don't** use gradient text or coloured glows (gold box-shadow, text-shadow or halo) on any element.
**Don't** make cards glass; glass is only for floating layers (nav, menus, dialog chrome, HUD, carousel arrows).
**Don't** colour subtitles, tags, resting icons or resting card borders gold.
**Don't** use built-in ease-in curves; state changes ease out.
**Don't** set Bodoni Moda below 24px for content.
